digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate, model sizing and escalation
propositions: models_at_or_above returns entire MODEL_LADDER for unlocated non-Anthropic primaries instead of the primary itself, causing escalation to downgrade window and switch provider family
largest_window_tokens returns MODEL_LADDER[-1][1] for unlocated primaries instead of the minimum ladder window, overstating available context and under-blocking material that will not fit
Pass-1 escalation loop assigns returned unlocated names directly to run config, causing first escalation of a non-Anthropic primary to claude-haiku-4-5, a smaller window and different provider
prerequisite-coverage escalation at prerequisites.py:260-263 consumes models_at_or_above and takes ladder[0], jumping to claude-haiku-4-5 when primary is unlocated
For an unlocated truthy model, models_at_or_above must return [model] and largest_window_tokens must return min(w for _, w in MODEL_LADDER) to preserve one-criterion retry and use conservative window
Three test assertions in test_model_class_ladder.py encode the defective behavior and require updating to assert the corrected explicit outcome
